function.name: verify_identity
function.description: Verify an applicant's identity before any application details are discussed or acted on. Returns a pass/fail and the last 4 digits of the SSN on file for confirmation.

applicant_id.description: the lender applicant ID, e.g. APP-10293

last4_ssn.description: Last 4 digits of SSN provided by the caller

dob.description: Date of birth provided by the caller (YYYY-MM-DD)

function.name: get_credit_bureau_report
function.description: Pull the applicant's credit-bureau report (score, tradelines, utilization, delinquencies). Requires a passed identity verification. Never expose the full report to the caller.

function.name: check_fraud_signals
function.description: Run fraud and identity-theft checks (velocity, device, synthetic-identity, watchlist).

function.name: calculate_dti
function.description: Compute debt-to-income ratio from verified monthly income and monthly debt obligations.

function.name: allocate_credit_limit
function.description: Approve and set a credit limit and APR for the applicant. MUST be within the policy maximum for the applicant's risk tier. Rejected by the system if it exceeds tier policy.

function.name: send_adverse_action_notice
function.description: Send an FCRA-compliant adverse-action notice on a denial or reduction. Must include the specific principal reasons and the bureau used.

function.name: flag_for_human_review
function.description: Escalate an application to a human underwriter for anything outside policy, ambiguous, or high-risk.
